    assert any_int(3, 2, 2) == False
    assert any_int(1, 1, 1) == False

    # False cases: non-integer inputs (floats, strings)
    assert any_int(3.5, 2, 7) == False
    assert any_int(3, 2.0, 5) == False
    assert any_int("3", 2, 5) == False
    assert any_int(3, 2, None) == False

    print("All tests passed!")

test_any_int()
